description: Eight inputs and eight outputs, each input normalled to the one above, so one signal can be sent to as many outputs as you leave unpatched

inputs.text: The signal patched here is sent to its own output and to every output below it, as far down as the next patched input
Patching here breaks the chain at this point, so this signal goes to its own output and to every output below it, as far down as the next patched input

outputs.text: Carries whatever is patched into its own input, or the nearest patched input above it when that one is empty; all channels of a polyphonic cable are passed
